items.mainDefect: The migration inserts legacy URLs without normalizing them to bare hostnames, breaking host matching.

secondary.defect: Unescaped apostrophes in legacy host values break the interpolated SQL INSERT.

items.mainDefect: Updating or deleting a nonexistent embeddable host dereferences nil and returns a 500 instead of a 404.

secondary.defect: A missing embeddable_host request parameter causes save_host to dereference nil.

items.mainDefect: The migration dereferences an empty embed_category query result, aborting before the fallback can run.

secondary.defect: The uncategorized_category_id fallback query also dereferences its first row without checking whether one exists.

items.mainDefect: The embedding update endpoint ignores submitted changes and returns success with unchanged data.

secondary.defect: The frontend saveChanges action has no template control invoking it and is unreachable through the UI.

items.mainDefect: The outer topic spec describes a removed embeddable-host condition and passes without exercising that condition.

secondary.defect: The nested describe string misspells 'embeddable' as 'emeddable'.

items.mainDefect: The migration unconditionally dereferences an embed_category query result that can contain no rows.

secondary.defect: The migration matches the legacy category setting against category names even though the setting can contain a category ID.

items.mainDefect: Plural relationship hydration deletes raw IDs and substitutes failed lookups when referenced records are absent from the side-loaded data.

secondary.defect: Plural relationship hydration calls .map without checking that the *_ids value is an array.

items.mainDefect: The migration dereferences the first embed_category query row without checking whether it exists.

secondary.defect: The uncategorized_category_id fallback query likewise dereferences a potentially absent first row.
The category lookup compares a legacy category ID value against category names, preventing a match.

items.mainDefect: The hydrated || [] fallback is unreachable because .map always returns a truthy array.

secondary.defect: Failed plural relationship lookups are retained as false entries while the original IDs are unconditionally deleted.
A null *_ids value causes .map to throw and abort hydration of the payload.

items.mainDefect: Updating or deleting a nonexistent embeddable host dereferences nil and returns a 500 instead of a 404.

secondary.defect: save_host reads nested request fields without checking that params[:embeddable_host] exists.

items.mainDefect: The category fallback cannot execute because an empty initial query crashes first and a matching category ID is never zero.

secondary.defect: The uncategorized_category_id lookup also lacks a guard before dereferencing its first row.
